items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Meet Jaffer. [INTERVIEWEE] It has an article in it by Dick Allen.

ctx.x: He got me over to New Orleans, and after that, I didn't care. I never did like Whirlines. I never was crazy about Whirlines. Sidney Bechet.
Mm-hmm. This is the Second Line magazine. Yeah. May 1953. Meet Jaffer.
It has an article in it by Dick Allen.
